description: This file contains utility functions and constants for testing web application features using Playwright, including server setup, booking workflows, email verification, and navigation helpers.

methods.name: createHttpServer
methods.description: Creates a mock HTTP server for testing, with request handling and request count waiting capabilities.

methods.name: selectFirstAvailableTimeSlotNextMonth
methods.description: Selects the first available time slot in the next month on a Playwright page.

methods.name: selectSecondAvailableTimeSlotNextMonth
methods.description: Selects the second available time slot in the next month on a Playwright page.

methods.name: bookEventOnThisPage
methods.description: Automates booking an event on the current page and verifies success.

methods.name: bookOptinEvent
methods.description: Books an opt-in event and verifies success.

methods.name: bookFirstEvent
methods.description: Books the first available event.

methods.name: bookTimeSlot
methods.description: Fills booking form and submits to book a time slot, with optional parameters.

methods.name: expectSlotNotAllowedToBook
methods.description: Verifies that a slot is not allowed to be booked.

methods.name: createNewUserEventType
methods.description: Creates a new user event type with specified title and optional username.

methods.name: setupManagedEvent
methods.description: Sets up a managed event with a team and users.

methods.name: createNewSeatedEventType
methods.description: Creates a new seated event type with seat options.

methods.name: createUserWithLimits
methods.description: Creates a user with specified event limits.

methods.name: createUserWithSeatedEvent
methods.description: Creates a user with a seated event type (not used elsewhere).

methods.name: createUserWithSeatedEventAndAttendees
methods.description: Creates a user with a seated event and attendees.

methods.name: generateTotpCode
methods.description: Generates a TOTP code based on email and environment key.

methods.name: fillStripeTestCheckout
methods.description: Fills Stripe test payment form.

methods.name: goToUrlWithErrorHandling
methods.description: Navigates to a URL with error handling for navigation failures.

methods.name: doOnOrgDomain
methods.description: Performs actions on a domain associated with an organization slug.

methods.name: gotoFirstEventType
methods.description: Navigates to the first event type page.

methods.name: gotoBookingPage
methods.description: Navigates to the booking page via preview link.

methods.name: saveEventType
methods.description: Saves event type changes via API call.

methods.name: submitAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Submits a form and waits for a response, asserting status code.

methods.name: submitAndWaitForJsonResponse
methods.description: Submits a form and waits for JSON response, asserting status code.

methods.name: confirmReschedule
methods.description: Confirms rescheduling of an event.

methods.name: confirmBooking
methods.description: Confirms a booking.

methods.name: bookTeamEvent
methods.description: Books a team event and verifies details.

methods.name: expectPageToBeNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that a page shows a 404 not found.

methods.name: setupOrgMember
methods.description: Sets up an organization member with team and event info.

methods.name: cancelBookingFromBookingsList
methods.description: Cancels a booking from the list and verifies cancellation.
